Hence, prayer is made to suspend the   of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on b  Shri Arvind Singh, learned Public Prosecutor for the re opposes the prayer made by learned counsel for appellant.

He further submits that appellant was misrepresenting himself to be a doctor and though he is in fact a quack and was wrongly treating the prosecutrix taking advantage of her relationship of trust and faith, he violated a privacy and therefore, no indulgence is required to be shown.

As far as the age of the prosecutrixt is concerned and chronology of the events which reveals that first incident took place on 18.08.2021 and then again after a month, prosecutrix had visited the same doctor despite knowing the fact that on 18.08.2021, she was made unconscious by injecting some injectable and her privacy was violated, again visiting the same doctor and the repetition of the incident reveals that there is an undercurrent of consent.

As far as degree of the doctor and misrepresentation are concerned that is always open to the State Authorities to check and take appropriate action under the appropriate law, which will be open to the Superintendent of Police, Sehor to take action against the present appellant.

After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and going through the material available on record,
there is no criminal history of the appellant, trial 3 CRA-15708-2023 is going to take time and there is consenting relationship between two adults but without commenting any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that present is a fit case for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No.3368 of 2024 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court concerned on 30.12.2024 and such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon Appellant Dr. Virendra @ Guddu Gour shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List this case for final hearing in due course.
